regions.name: Punjab & Haryana
regions.story: Rice-straw burning after the October harvest, and wheat stubble in April and May.

regions.name: Western Uttar Pradesh
regions.story: The eastern end of the rice-wheat belt, with the same October to November stubble season.

regions.name: Madhya Pradesh
regions.story: Wheat residue burning that peaks from March to May, plus fires in its forests.
